notes: v526 — 🪜 Profit ladder for a single share. The ⋯ menu on any holding now has “🪜 Profit ladder (this share)” next to the trailing stop: pick a rung size and every time the gain climbs another rung, a sell floor is welded underneath — it only ever rises, so a proven gain can never fully round-trip. Works exactly like the auto-pilot's ladder, but on just the shares you choose, with your own rung size. The ladder rides the 🪤 trailing stop — if the share doesn't have one, the app offers to switch it on, or tells you plainly the ladder stays dormant until you do. Blank removes it. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
